messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> reserved-pool-latency Vectra (tenant=vectra-01) p95 > 1200ms. page: PDR-8231. auto-escalate in 5m if not acked
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-8231 assigned to @oncall (alice). Priority: high. See: https://pagerduty.example/pdr/PDR-8231
alice: on it, pulling traces. any recent deploys to dedicated clusters? :eyes:
ben: not that I know of. infra autoscaler triggered a burst last night for several tenants but Vectra had sustained traffic increase this morning.
carmen: seeing KV cache evictions on vectra-01, lots of prefix misses. logs show repeated fallback to disk. snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:01:12Z [serving/runtime] tenant=vectra-01 kvcache: eviction_count=1245 prefix_miss=0.32 p95_lat=1300ms
2026-03-15T09:03:08Z [router] route=reserved -> fallback=shared-ondemand model=llama-13b-quant p95=1400ms
```
alice: ok that matches customer report of intermittent 503s earlier. are we hitting reserved capacity throttle? metrics?
dino: dashboard shows reserved_pool_utilization vectra-01 at 99% and throttled_requests spiking. Also OOM-ish logs on a worker: "CUDA memory allocation failed" repeated.
ops-manager: tagging legal & customer success for awareness: @cs-vectra.impact (no PII in logs).
alice: i'm going to attempt a manual soft-burst increase for vectra-01 + enable immediate fallback routing to lower-cost variant to keep latency sensible. command i'll run: `rictl reserved adjust --tenant vectra-01 --add-gpus 2 --duration 10m`
ben: +1. also suggest increasing KV cache size on that pool temporarily: `rictl pool update --pool vectra-01 --kv-cache-size 12GB` (watch host mem).
carmen: if we bump KV cache we might push other tenants on the same host — is vectra-01 isolated (dedicated)?
dino: vectra-01 is in dedicated reserved pool but shares nodes with vectra-02 for binpacking. changing kv cache will affect vectra-02. recommend soft-burst instead.
alice: acking the page now (PagerDuty ack). alice: Acked PDR-8231, taking lead. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-8231 acknowledged by alice. Auto-escalation paused.
alice: running soft-burst increase now. will monitor p95 and errors.
(30s) system: command output:
```
rictl reserved adjust --tenant vectra-01 --add-gpus 2 --duration 10m
> submitted change request id: adj-9854 state: applied
```
carmen: seeing p95 drop from 1300ms -> 480ms, good. but there is a small increase in 5xx rate (from 0.1% -> 0.6%).
ben: 5xx trace points to KV fallback misses hitting storage backend (higher tail). might be transient as cache warms.
alice: rolling partial route change to send non-critical traffic to ondemand pool: `rictl routing update --tenant vectra-01 --route non-critical=ondemand-13b`
(2m) system: routing update applied.
dino: confirming worker memory stabilized, CUDA errors subsided. reserved utilization now ~82%.
ops-manager: customer impact note: customer-facing API p95 improved, but background inference jobs (non-critical) saw failed runs ~3% during the incident window. Recommend CS notify customer with mitigation summary.
alice: creating short incident summary and scheduling RCA. initial mitigation: soft-burst + routing change + cache warming. next steps: investigate why KV cache eviction spike occurred and why autoscaler didn't pre-provision earlier.
ben: adding checklist to postmortem: (1) KV cache eviction thresholds tuning, (2) reserved pool headroom alarms, (3) autoscaler step-up aggressive policy for ded+tenants with >85% sustained util, (4) model fallback throttling behavior.
alice: handing off to night oncall (dino) in 10m. dino, if p95 climbs back above 800ms or 5xx > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes, escalate to PD high again.
dino: copy. I'm on watch. thanks team. :v:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-8231 status updated -> resolved (manual close by alice) at 1768010400.
alice: closing thread. saving logs to /incidents/PDR-8231 and flagging for 2-hour post-incident sync.
ops-manager: filed customer impact email draft, assigning to @cs-vectra for review.
carmen: leaving a note: possible regression from recent kvcache eviction algorithm change rolled two weeks ago. will include runbook patch in RCA.
alice: thanks everyone, great quick coordination. :pray:
